findings.summary: ClassView docstring says a container holding a removed key is no value, but only containers holding a masked value are rejected; a pointer above an ABSENT removal resolves against the reduced container (e.g. '/s'=[] when the raw list held secrets). Not an oracle, but a grounded claim the provider data contradicts.
Allowed by ruling: a fallback turn's raw view is still checked through the class view (stricter); bound and budget stubs are not applied.

Coverage confirmed: R1-1 closed, rules identical to the assembler's except bound/budget, off unchanged, no golden changed. Nits: _run_modes computed twice; no kernel test for shadow with context_assembler on; unused '[masked:secret]' marker.
